title: HSBall 솔로 #052 · 아워글래스SSBBW · Turkish İznik tile · 쇠공 손목 체인으로 끌기(옆모습) · plump glossy rose-coral lips
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with rough-cut stone block walls on each side of her, a low vaulted stone ceiling, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus from head to toe, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Subject: ONE real adult Korean woman in her late 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, glowing dewy skin, a precise winged liner, softly defined brown eyeshadow, full natural lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, sculpted contour with a satin highlight, plump glossy rose-coral lips, a faintly overwhelmed look, her eyes damp and her breath caught in slightly parted lips, deep jet-black with a glossy sheen hair styled in a crown braid wrapping around the head, real living eyes. Long square nails, chrome finish.

Physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. A colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size. Below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops down under its own weight, projecting forward past the line of her own knees, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds, not pregnant. Enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Skin: Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a smooth taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds, faint stretch marks where the great curves have expanded. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Turkish İznik tile — a brilliant white ground with cobalt-blue tulips and curling stems, wide cobalt-and-coral bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense floral scrollwork filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her body below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line. The color has dulled and cracked along her ribs, waist and thighs, rubbed bare in thin streaks over her shoulders and the backs of her knees so her skin shows through the worn paint. Soot darkens her nose, cheeks and chin, damp strands of hair stick to her cheeks and neck, dirt is ground into her knees, calves and elbows, and her bare feet are caked with soot and grime.

Restraints: Her wrists wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ring linked by a long thick chain of massive black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, that runs back along her sides to a huge rough-cast black iron ball as big as a bowling ball dragging on the flagstones behind her, the chains pulled taut by its weight so her arms are drawn back. Her ankles wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, joined by a short chain of the same links.

Pose: walking slowly, her body turned in profile to the camera and her face turned toward the camera, leaning forward against the pull with her arms drawn back along her sides to the chains, the iron ball dragging on the flagstones behind her, her bare feet flat on the flagstones, her whole body straining with fatigue, her chest, shoulders and stomach in view.

Footwear: bare feet flat on the flagstones, the soles, toes and tops of her feet streaked with soot and dirt.

Background & Lighting: the dim light catching the painted pattern in sharp glints, carving every fold and curve.

Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide. portrait 2:3 vertical.
